The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kothlis/Legends|Kothlis]]' [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Tal'cara]] included a crime-ridden '''warehouse district'''. It occupied the southern areas of the city, and to the east included a couple of apartment complexes.<ref name="guide">''[[Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide]]''</ref>

A modified [[monorail/Legends|unirail]] cargo line connected the [[Kothlis starport]] with the warehouses. Hatches on the ground (and the unirail's ceiling) facilitated loading and unloading. There was such a transfer station in every warehouse.<ref name="guide" />

The area was dimly-lit and grimy, frequented by outcasts and criminals. Local [[Bothan police force|police]] patrols avoided the area at all costs.<ref name="guide" />

Many of the warehouses were actually fronts for spy safehouses and facilities. They were so well camouflaged that no being could discover them, even if one was looking for one. [[Torel Fey'jia]]'s underground [[Spynet Facility]] was located 400 [[meter/Legends|meters]] away from the unirail loading hatch of a (intentionally) abandoned and dilapidated building with scattered empty [[transcube]]s.<ref name="guide" />

It housed [[Merkur's Cab Service]] as well as a [[Bothan safehouse]] under [[Koth Melan]].<ref name="guide" />
